versions.changelog: Adds a status note at the top of SKILL.md: reads, guards and mutation shapes are tested; a live write has not yet been run on a real store.

Initial release. Everything shopify-audit-pro does, plus guarded writes via a single mutate command: preview by default, --confirm to send, a second exact confirmation for high-risk mutations, no retry after ambiguous write failures, userErrors treated as failures, PII-free audit log. Reads, guards and mutation shapes are tested; a live write has not yet been run on a real store.
